title: Cross-scale organisation of the atmospheric circulation: a falsification-grade research programme (Shroedinger, gen4)
description:
v6.1 — reproducibility release for the manuscripts. Numerical results are identical to v6.0; this release adds the per-paper reproduction infrastructure and the journal-ready manuscript of paper 1 of the series.

  • reproducibility/article1_README.md — the complete route from primary data to every table row and figure of paper 1 (regional invariant): version pin, primary-source table (ERA5 / MERRA-2 / HighResMIP / GEFS / WeatherBench 2), a result-to-script mapping over the ten experiments behind the paper, pinned environment, SHA-256 of all expected artifacts, access caveats, and a single-region-window smoke test that avoids bulk downloads.
  • reproducibility/reproduce_article1.py — one-command orchestrator (--stage download | compute | check); the artifact check verifies 12/12 stored results.
  • manuscript_v2/article1_v5.tex — the journal-ready manuscript (Izvestia RAN, GOST bibliography, dual-engine preamble), revised through three external review rounds; its Data Availability Statement points to this release.

Raw ERA5 / MERRA-2 / HighResMIP fields are deliberately not stored (large externally licensed products); the exact download scripts and all derived tables behind the papers’ statistics are included. For the full scientific record of the programme (Phases 1–23, AUDIT-1..4, verdicts and retractions) see the v6.0 release notes and docs/RECONCILIATION.md.
notes: Supersedes release v5.0. Adds Phases 14-23, the theory candidate with scored predictions, and the four methods audits (AUDIT-1..4) that settle the estimator's novelty against prior art and correct the map's reliability ceiling from 0.603 to 0.914. The analysis programme closes with this release.
